answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained useful work, like a crystal forming slowly layer by layer. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so creating a lagoon of thousands of sock puppets becomes prohibitively expensive. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fees, while detected fakes forfeit it, and the deposit steps up on each terrace of reputation so high-volume identities cost more to fake than they can earn.
